description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs chain_walk(): RFC 5280 §6.1.5 is the post-loop finalization step. Steps §6.1.5(a-b) are implemented inside the for-loop with an i==0 guard (lines 1970-1985) rather than after the loop ends. This is functionally equivalent because i==0 is always the final loop iteration, but it violates the structural correspondence between the code and the RFC section numbering. The comment // (policy-leaf) §6.1.5(a-b) inside the loop can mislead future maintainers who consult RFC 5280 and find §6.1.5 is a post-loop step. The final check at line 2415 is correctly post-loop. Refactoring §6.1.5(a-b) to post-loop would make the code structurally match the RFC and eliminate any future doubt about ordering relative to other per-cert checks.
title: §6.1.5(a-b) leaf policy finalization placed inside loop instead of post-loop
